actors.OWNER: The Discord server owner / management-authorized account A.
actors.MEMBER: The second available test account B without Administration role.
actors.MEMBER_ADMIN: Account B after the managed Administration role is explicitly granted for role-based authorization tests.

cases.precondition: Account B has no server-owner status and no managed Administration role.
cases.action: Attempt each management command where Discord exposes it.
cases.expectation: The command is denied and no Discord or persisted state is mutated.

cases.precondition: Account A owns the dedicated test guild and bot preflight requirements are satisfied.
cases.action: Run each command with valid parameters in its scenario-specific test case.
cases.expectation: Authorization passes; command-specific validation remains the next boundary.

cases.precondition: Account B has the exact managed Administration role and is not the guild owner.
cases.expectation: Authorization passes through the configured Administration role; owner-only commands remain owner-only.

cases.precondition: Account B is not the guild owner.
cases.expectation: The commands are denied and no state changes occur.

cases.precondition: Target account B has a managed student role.
cases.action: Attempt to assign B as a teacher.
cases.expectation: Assignment is rejected while the student role conflict exists.

cases.precondition: Target account B is a valid student candidate with an existing managed student-stream assignment.
cases.action: Assign B to a different configured stream.
cases.expectation: Student-stream assignment roles are normalized instead of accumulating conflicting assignments.

cases.precondition: Target account B has one managed professor gender role.
cases.action: Assign the opposite professor gender option.
cases.expectation: The previous managed professor gender role is removed before/with the new assignment.

cases.precondition: Two test accounts are available; a selected professor is valid and a student assignment state is known.
cases.action: Try to assign a member who still has a student role as a subject teacher.
cases.expectation: The role conflict is rejected without partially changing the subject access configuration.

cases.precondition: Managed roles exist with known hierarchy positions.
cases.action: Lower the bot role below a managed role, then invoke a role-mutating command.
cases.expectation: Role preflight blocks the mutation rather than partially applying role changes.

cases.precondition: The bot lacks Manage Channels in the E2E guild.
cases.expectation: Channel mutation is blocked before Discord resources are changed.

cases.precondition: The bot lacks Manage Roles in the E2E guild.
cases.expectation: Role mutation is blocked before managed-role state can drift.
